title: None of the Others: a General Technique to Distinguish Reasoning from Memorization in Multiple-Choice LLM Evaluation Benchmarks

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the performance drop of LLMs on a public, likely contaminated dataset (MMLU) versus a private, uncontaminated dataset (UNED-Access 2024) when applying the 'None of the others' (NOTO) answer substitution to test reliance on memorized training data.

Contrasting model performance on questions presented in their original source language versus manually translated versions to determine if high accuracy relies on retrieving verbatim strings seen during pretraining rather than genuine reasoning.
